entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Kingdom of Simien, also known as the Kingdom of Beta Israel, refers to a semi-legendary Jewish kingdom said to have been located in the northwestern part of the Ethiopian Empire. The existence of such a kingdom somewhere in the Horn of Africa was first mentioned by the traveller Benjamin of Tudela in the 12th century CE.
